description:
Moves jit's scattered content-standards guidance (issue-description structure, `[hard]`/`[aspirational]` criteria markers, `REQ-NN` ids, clean titles, standalone-readability, Mermaid/LaTeX rules) into a single versioned document that every consumer references directly, replacing two byte-identical copies.

## Background

The content standards currently live at `.claude/skills/jit-manage/references/content-standards.md` (168 lines) and are duplicated byte-for-byte at `.claude/skills/jit-planning-lead/references/content-standards.md`. Seven other locations point at the `jit-manage` copy: `jit-execution-lead/references/doc-agent-prompt.md`, `jit-execution-lead/references/architect-agent-prompt.md`, `jit-breakdown/references/analysis-prompt.md`, two mentions in `jit-breakdown/SKILL.md`, `jit-manage/SKILL.md`, and `jit-manage/references/design-doc-template.md`.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `docs/reference/jit-content-standards.md` is the single physical copy of the content standards, versioned under `docs/` (a `permanent_paths` location, never auto-archived).
- [hard] REQ-02: Both existing copies (`jit-manage/references/content-standards.md` and `jit-planning-lead/references/content-standards.md`) are deleted in the same change, with no stub or pointer file left in their place.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every known consumer reference is repointed to a direct, skill-base-relative path to the canonical doc (`../../../docs/reference/jit-content-standards.md` from a skill's root, one `../` deeper from a `references/` file): `jit-execution-lead/references/doc-agent-prompt.md`, `jit-execution-lead/references/architect-agent-prompt.md`, `jit-breakdown/references/analysis-prompt.md`, `jit-breakdown/SKILL.md`, `jit-manage/SKILL.md`, `jit-manage/references/design-doc-template.md`, and `jit-planning-lead/SKILL.md`.
- [hard] REQ-04: The skill-base-relative reference resolves correctly even when a skill is entered through its `~/.claude/skills` symlink, since every jit skill there is a per-skill symlink into this repository's `.claude/skills`.

## Notes

Land the move, the deletions, and every reference update together — an intermediate state with the doc moved but references unfixed (or the duplicates still present) recreates the scattered-copies problem this item exists to close.
title: Promote content standards to a canonical doc
